title: Model Serving / Inference Services
description: Latency, token throughput, requests and KV cache usage of MPlatform inference services, from the vLLM (vllm:) and SGLang (sglang:) metrics their serving pods expose. The PodMonitor created with each service labels the series with inference_service and inference_role.

panels.title: Time to First Token
panels.description: p50 and p95 of vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds or sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds, from when a request reaches the serving pod. Prefill pods of pd services are left out; on decode pods it includes waiting for the KV cache transfer. The time to first token a client of a pd service sees needs the router's metrics, which the platform does not collect yet.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket|sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket|sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Inter-Token Latency
panels.description: p50 and p95 of vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds or sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds, the time between consecutive output tokens. Prefill pods of pd services are left out, as they do not decode.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket|sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket|sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: End-to-End Request Latency
panels.description: p50 and p95 of vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds or sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds, from when a request reaches the serving pod. Prefill pods of pd services are left out, so a pd service shows its decode pods, without the router.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket|sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket|sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Token Throughput (tokens/s)
panels.description: Input tokens from vllm:prompt_tokens_total or sglang:prompt_tokens_total and output tokens from vllm:generation_tokens_total or sglang:generation_tokens_total, per second. In pd services input tokens are counted on prefill pods and output tokens on decode pods, which both see every request.

targets.expr: sum by (inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:prompt_tokens_total|sglang:prompt_tokens_total", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="decode"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (inference_service, inference_role) (rate({__name__=~"vllm:generation_tokens_total|sglang:generation_tokens_total", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role", inference_role!="prefill"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Running and Queued Requests
panels.description: Requests being processed (vllm:num_requests_running or sglang:num_running_reqs) and waiting in the queue (vllm:num_requests_waiting or sglang:num_queue_reqs).

targets.expr: sum by (inference_service, inference_role) ({__name__=~"vllm:num_requests_running|sglang:num_running_reqs", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role"})
sum by (inference_service, inference_role) ({__name__=~"vllm:num_requests_waiting|sglang:num_queue_reqs", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role"})

panels.title: KV Cache Usage
panels.description: Fraction of the KV cache in use on each serving pod, from vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc or sglang:token_usage.

targets.expr: max by (inference_service, inference_role, pod) ({__name__=~"vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc|sglang:token_usage", namespace="$namespace", inference_service=~"$service", inference_role=~"$role"})
